name: api-management-gateway
description: VNet-integrated API Management fronting a private App Service backend, with a rate-limited product, App Insights logging, and a published API.
what: An API Management service deployed in External VNet mode with a hardened subnet NSG, fronting a private App Service backend reachable only through the gateway over the VNet. A published product applies a rate-limit policy, subscriptions gate access, and gateway telemetry flows to Application Insights.
why: Enterprises expose dozens of backend services and need one governed, observable, throttled entry point rather than bespoke per-app gateways. This establishes the API platform with VNet isolation, policy, and metering as first-class concerns.
potentialUseCases: Central API platform for internal and partner APIs
Monetized or quota-limited public API program
Facade and versioning layer in front of legacy services
Policy enforcement (auth, rate limit, transformation) at the edge

reliability: Premium APIM with multiple scale units in prod
security: Backend App Service has public access disabled; only APIM reaches it
APIM injected into a VNet with a least-privilege NSG
costOptimization: Developer SKU and P0v3 backend in dev
operationalExcellence: Gateway telemetry to Application Insights and Log Analytics
Policy and product defined as code
performanceEfficiency: Rate-limit policy protects backends from overload
APIM caching and scale units tune throughput

cost.profile: Prod profile: Premium APIM x2 units, P1v3 x3 backend.
